'''Madoka Asahina''' (Japanese: '''朝日奈丸佳''' ''Asahina Madoka'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Asahina was born on December 17, 1993 in {{wp|Shizuoka, Shizuoka}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, voicing [[Team Skull]] member [[Rapp]], one of her best-known roles to date. Asahina is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
